summary: Pioneer Power Solutions, Inc. (PPSI), a Nasdaq Capital Market-listed power solutions company headquartered in Fort Lee, New Jersey, filed a Form 8-K on April 8, 2026 disclosing Q4 and full year 2025 financial results via an attached press release (Exhibit 99.1). No specific financial figures are contained in the 8-K itself; the filing only references the results. This is a routine corporate disclosure outside the scope of market structure or macro catalysts.
